description: Permanently delete one of your pilot VMs and its boot disk, including all stored data. Requires explicit user authorization. Use the occupied operation id from get_private_vps_pilot, not a paid VM id. After deletion is verified its one-per-account slot becomes available for a new create_private_vps request. Keeps account approval, the other pilot, private networking and the existing outgoing allowance. Does not reset the monthly budget.

confirmed.description: Set only after the user authorizes deleting this pilot and its data.

name: delete_private_vps
title: Delete a pilot VPS
